reason: A DSH Web client plugin for scheduling messages with smart or custom send times, queued tasks, browser-local persistence, and automatic sending.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供定时发送功能，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多任务排队及浏览器本地持久化。
summaries.en: Adds scheduled message sending to DSH Web with smart or custom times, queued tasks, and browser-local persistence.

capabilities: Schedules messages for later sending in the DSH Web input interface
Supports smart time windows and custom dates and times
Persists scheduled tasks and preferences in browser localStorage
Automatically sends due messages and cancels a task if the draft has changed
